# kickmix 1.0.0 (vendored)

Unmodified source of kickmix 1.0.0 from the PyPI sdist (`pip download kickmix==1.0.0 --no-binary :all:`),
part of Qualtran (Google Quantum AI). License: Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE`, copied from the Kaggle competition data
`kickmix/LICENSE.txt`). Only the generated `kickmix.egg-info/` directory was left out.

Vendored for the Kaggle "Google Verifiable Quantum Circuit Compilation" work in `../../` (building and
simulating kickmix circuits, reading the C++ gate generators such as `src/kickmix/gen/adders/`).
